decisions.reason: 투입된 is deployment, not merely that they fought; BASE’s ‘thrown in’ is truncated.
decisions.replacement: And a major one, no less—hundreds of people had been thrown into it. My heart lurched for a moment, but then I remembered what Wipeng had said earlier.

decisions.reason: 들은 셈이다 is that he’d already heard the outcome; SOL makes Wipeng the teller.
전투 is battle, but 새로 생긴 is not in this line; SOL adds ‘fresh’ too early.
decisions.replacement: Judging by the scar running from Wipeng’s forehead to his chin, it must have been a fierce battle.

decisions.reason: 입장에서는 and 쏟아부은 keep the family’s perspective and the poured-strength image SOL drops.
잡은/수확 is taking a haul, not ‘bringing down’ a ‘gain.’
썅귀 is a swear-mishearing of 쌍귀, not a stutter on Twin.
Italic Twin is the correction 항산쌍귀 말입니다 after the 썅 mishear.
새로 생긴 상처 is a fresh scar, not merely ‘new.’
Source has 중요한 정보, not ‘some’ information.
호로록 들이켜는 is a noisy slurp/gulp, not a sip.
BASE’s injury line is a fragment; SOL’s ‘Then’ weakens 그러고도; 뻗어 is out cold.
decisions.replacement: It had been the fiercest fight of my twenty-seven years. I’d suffered all kinds of internal injuries and been sliced up like a steak. I’d been out cold for five days after that, so I’d practically taken a half-bath in the River Jordan.[^1]

decisions.reason: Turns the 뭐, 제법 fragment into a complete incredulous beat without adding content.
Keep 이번 기회에 and 급이 as levels; 천만다행 is ‘Thank God,’ not mere relief, and not ‘tiers.’
decisions.replacement: I learned something for certain this time: even Peak masters came in different levels. Thank God people of that caliber were on my side.

decisions.reason: 눈빛 is a look, not a facial expression; 응시 is closer to regarded than looked.
BASE covers 말로도 표현이 불가능 more tightly; SOL pads with ‘what you accomplished.’
‘Being praised’ is the natural English of 칭찬받은, not ‘getting praised.’
뭐 감사합니다 is a brushed-off ‘thanks, I guess,’ not a full thank-you.
Split 몸 상태/기분 naturally but keep 밀려 있는 as still waiting.
decisions.replacement: I wanted to wrap up the Jopil talk there. My body was in bad shape, my mood wasn’t much better, and I wanted to check the System Rewards still waiting for me.

decisions.reason: 쉬자 plus 인마 is ‘let me rest already,’ not a shared ‘let’s rest.’
날리자 is throwing a wink; SOL’s ‘tried’ telegraphs failure the source doesn’t.
decisions.replacement: I threw him a wink with that meaning. Wipeng frowned.

decisions.reason: Wipeng repeats 경련; SOL drops the insisted word ‘spasm.’
Interrupted ‘what I just did’ is more natural speech than ‘just now, that was.’
부르르 떨었다 is trembling; ‘violently’ front-loads intensity the next line already shows.
Sloshed over the rim fits the shaking table better than a static spill.
간질 환자/간질에 걸렸대 is having epilepsy, not the label ‘epileptic.’
정상으로 돌아온 plus 평온한 얼굴 is composed again; ‘calm face’ is body-part calque.
무슨 종류의 또라이야 is a rhetorical question.
말문이 막혔다 needs a full English idiom; ‘the words stuck’ is truncated.
‘Nodded, satisfied’ is tighter 만족스럽게 than ‘in satisfaction.’
또라이 새끼 is a bare epithet, not ‘you crazy bastard.’
‘My fight’ is cleaner POV English than ‘the fight with Jopil,’ without changing the event.
날카로운 is sharp; ‘incisive’ is a Latinate register bump, and the split fragments the one clause.
Later 그걸/비수를 are singular; BASE’s plural daggers contradict that.
숨겨 둔 거 is the one hidden dagger, matching the singular follow-up.
그걸 is singular ‘it,’ not ‘them.’
복잡한 심정이 그대로 전해진다 is mixed feelings coming through, not a ‘conflicted look’ that ‘told me how he felt.’
Vocative 삼공자. is its own formal beat; the comma flattens Wipeng’s pause.
진심입니다 is ‘I mean it,’ not ‘I mean that.’
예 is yes, not ‘right.’
Second 진심입니다 is also ‘I mean it’; BASE’s ‘that’ is the weaker idiom.
주루/갖다 바치고/활보 are pleasure houses, pouring money in, and parading drunk; SOL’s taverns and staggering change place and gait.
Drops the redundant ‘and said’ before the quote; ‘burst out of me’ completes 튀어나오려는.
Keep 누가…핑계; SOL’s ‘changes nothing’ drops excuse, while BASE underplays 고작 그 정도.
decisions.replacement: “No. It was all skill. Who let their guard down and who hid a dagger beforehand are not excuses. If that alone had been enough to kill Jopil, he would not have been Jopil, One Question, One Kill. Murim is a place where only the strong survive.”

decisions.reason: 어딘지 모르게 is ‘somehow,’ which BASE omits.
강해진 is ‘grown stronger,’ the natural English of that result.
끌어올렸 is pulling/raising innate qi, not generic ‘drew upon.’
떨떠름 is sour; ‘uncomfortable’ weakens it and ‘dead serious’ intensifies 정색.
기습으로 is instrumental ‘with a surprise attack,’ not ‘in.’
피식 웃었다 is a short chuckle, not a quiet laugh.
바라봤다 is looked; ‘regarded him’ is a polish synonym, not better.
Added ‘that’ is indistinguishable filler.
왠지 모르게 민망해져서 is ‘for some reason I felt embarrassed,’ not ‘I got embarrassed.’
통틀어도 needs ‘even across’; BASE drops that concession.
그런 절정 고수 is ‘Peak masters like that’; SOL drops 그런.
따로 있지요 is more naturally ‘lies elsewhere’ than ‘is something else.’
쓰지 않아도 is using poison, not ‘resorting to’; 암, 그렇고말고 is ‘that’s exactly right,’ not ‘yes, indeed.’
This sentence doesn’t restated 문가; doorway is already in the prior line.
The rant’s ‘even if I ripped’ keeps Wikyung’s first-person violence; the gerund flattens it.
과한 몰입감 is getting way too into the story; ‘invested’ is stiffer, and 초토화 is wreckage.
멀찍이 떨어져서 is backing far away; ‘safe distance’ adds an unsupported motive.
다시 안 하는 게 is not telling that story again, not merely not bringing it up.
슬픈 눈으로 is the sad-eyes gag; ‘watched sadly’ erases the body image.
주군. is a formal vocative pause, same as the earlier 삼공자. beat.
Keep 이번 말은 as ‘that one’ and 슬픈 눈으로; SOL’s ‘forlorn expression’ over-specifies.
decisions.replacement: That one actually worked. Seeing me sitting there with sad eyes, wrapped in bandages from head to toe, Jin Wikyung’s eyes reddened.

decisions.reason: 어린 녀석 is this child, the infantilization the next lines pay off; ‘young man’ ages him up.
덥석! is a standalone grab SFX like the booms; deleting it drops the beat.
A cauldron-lid hand 잡고 is clamping on, more physical than ‘seized’ after Grab!
‘After ending an embrace’ is stiff; 포옹 is a hug, and 끝낸 is already implied by after.
이제 다 컸구나 is ‘now you’re all grown up,’ not merely ‘you’ve grown up now.’
숨도 쉬지 않고 is answering without pausing to breathe, the English idiom for that rush.
저잣거리 is the marketplace, but 식솔들 is the household, not generic people.
decisions.replacement: “Rumors have spread throughout our family and even into the marketplace. The tale of the hero who led a death squad in a raid on the enemy camp, defeated Jopil, One Question, One Kill, and one hundred wandering martial artists, and rescued the Sakju Branch’s household.”

decisions.reason: 흐뭇하게 is pleased/fond, not satisfaction.
우리 막내 is our baby brother; SOL’s ‘my’ drops 우리, BASE’s ‘little’ breaks 막내 continuity.
decisions.replacement: “Our baby brother is modest, too. Wipeng, you shut your mouth.”

decisions.reason: 좀 왜곡된 is spoken ‘gotten a little distorted,’ not the passive ‘has been distorted.’
허황된 소문 collocates as far-fetched; outlandish is only a synonym.
Same 허황 echo; keep far-fetched with the prior line.
입을 딱 벌렸다 is the mouth falling open, cleaner than staring-with-mouth-hanging-open.
압축된 공기가 터져 나가는 소리 is that bursting sound; SOL adds an unsupported deafening roar.
Started/began shouting are indistinguishable for 아우성을 쳤다.
삼공차 is a panicked slip off 삼공자; SOL smooths the mis-shout away.
충격에서 벗어나지 못하고 is still reeling from shock; ‘stuck in shock’ is calqued.
한 발. 한 발. is deliberate repetition; SOL’s ‘then another’ and ‘fresh wave’ rewrite it.
말이 좋아 이 층이지 is two stories in name only; BASE underplays that.
최소 골절이다 is a fracture at minimum, not generic breaking bones.
고개를 꺾어 looking up is craning; ‘heads cranked back’ is calqued 꺾어.
누군가의 외침 is someone’s shout; SOL drops 누군가.
삼공자님 is a polite upgrade, not ‘Lord’; sir matches 님 without raising rank.
이게 뭔 상황이야 is that question; BASE is stiff and SOL adds hell the line doesn’t have.
눈과 귀가 홱홱 돌아갈 is eyes and ears whipping around; SOL genericizes it into a spinning head.
파묻혀 사라졌다 is swallowed/buried by the shouts, stronger than ‘vanished beneath.’
시선이 우수수 날아와 꽂힌다 is gazes flying up and pinning him; ‘stuck’ is calqued 꽂힌다.
이게 무슨 has no 시발; SOL adds hell.
겨드랑이로 손을 집어넣었다 is shoving hands into the armpits; ‘slid under’ sanitizes the action.
아기 사자도 아니고 is the lifted-cub joke as ‘what am I,’ which lands better than ‘what is this.’
